<div class="course-intro">

## Statistics 101 for Graduate Pharmaceutical Studies

Probability, statistical inference, data analysis, and modern quantitative methods.

Select a week below to open the lecture slides.

</div>

<div class="week-grid">

<a class="week-card" href="week01/week01.html">
<span class="week-number">Week 01</span>
<span class="week-title">Probability foundations</span>
<span class="week-desc">Probability, events, conditional probability, independence, and Bayes' rule.</span>
</a>

<a class="week-card" href="week02/week02.html">
<span class="week-number">Week 02</span>
<span class="week-title">Probability distributions</span>
<span class="week-desc">Random variables, discrete and continuous distributions, expectation, and variance.</span>
</a>

<a class="week-card" href="week03/week03.html">
<span class="week-number">Week 03</span>
<span class="week-title">From probability to data</span>
<span class="week-desc">Estimation, likelihood, study design, bias, causality, and descriptive statistics.</span>
</a>

<a class="week-card" href="week04/week04.html">
<span class="week-number">Week 04</span>
<span class="week-title">Understanding data</span>
<span class="week-desc">Information, data structures, transformations, missingness, and visualization.</span>
</a>

<a class="week-card" href="week05/week05.html">
<span class="week-number">Week 05</span>
<span class="week-title">Sampling distributions</span>
<span class="week-desc">Law of large numbers, central limit theorem, t, chi-squared, and F distributions.</span>
</a>

<a class="week-card" href="week06/week06.html">
<span class="week-number">Week 06</span>
<span class="week-title">Statistical inference</span>
<span class="week-desc">Confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, errors, power, and multiplicity.</span>
</a>

<a class="week-card" href="week07/week07.html">
<span class="week-number">Week 07</span>
<span class="week-title">Comparing groups</span>
<span class="week-desc">Categorical tests, t tests, ANOVA, interactions, equivalence, and agreement.</span>
</a>

<a class="week-card" href="week08/week08.html">
<span class="week-number">Week 08</span>
<span class="week-title">Association and regression</span>
<span class="week-desc">Correlation, linear regression, and foundations of generalized linear models.</span>
</a>

<a class="week-card" href="week09/week09.html">
<span class="week-number">Week 09</span>
<span class="week-title">Generalized models</span>
<span class="week-desc">Odds, logistic models, generalized linear models, and nonparametric methods.</span>
</a>

<a class="week-card" href="week10/week10.html">
<span class="week-number">Week 10</span>
<span class="week-title">Applications in pharmaceutical science</span>
<span class="week-desc">Epidemiology, diagnostics, clinical trials, toxicology, and meta-analysis.</span>
</a>

<a class="week-card" href="week11/week11.html">
<span class="week-number">Week 11</span>
<span class="week-title">Time and prediction</span>
<span class="week-desc">Signals, time series, survival analysis, missing data, and prediction.</span>
</a>

<a class="week-card" href="week12/week12.html">
<span class="week-number">Week 12</span>
<span class="week-title">Multivariate and machine learning methods</span>
<span class="week-desc">PCA, factor analysis, clustering, multivariate methods, and machine learning.</span>
</a>

</div>
